newsitem.title: FRANCE: French digital mobile phone use up 6.8 pct in Sept.
newsitem.headline: French digital mobile phone use up 6.8 pct in Sept.

text.p: The number of French digital mobile phones increased 6.8 percent to 1,752,400 in September, the ministry for post and telecommunications said.
France Telecom's Itineris service rose by 5.7 percent to 1,091,100. Generale des Eaux 's SFR had an increase of 6.7 percent to 600,800 and newcomer Bouygues Telecom saw a 40.4 percent rise to 44,800.
The rest of the total in French subscribers are at the La Reunion Island's SRR, a unit of SFR, and the France Telecom Ameris service in the Caribbean.
